QuestInfo.0: Why did #p1032106# give the #t4033008# to #p1012110#? What does it mean? Get some answers from #p1032101#.

QuestInfo.2: Once #p1012110# understood the meaning behind the #t4033008#, she almost cried with joy. You've done a great thing, bringing these two together.
